title: Inject named processes, telemetry handlers, Logger levels, Oban and env

epic.name: Async test suite through dependency injection

story.i_want_to: my own instance of every named process, handler and setting I touch
story.so_that: I never change it for another test

rationale: These modules are sync because they start a named process, attach a VM-global telemetry handler, change a Logger level, use a global Oban mode, or read an env var or path.

acceptance_criteria.description: Every converted module is `async: true`; the commit gate passes; production behaviour is unchanged (the injected input defaults to the value the code read before).
Named servers and tables take :name; handlers take a per-test id and filter on the test's key; Logger levels are raised once in test_helper.exs; Oban takes the instance; env and paths are arguments.
